page.overview:
What is Ammathair Hawkfeather's residence?

Ammathair Hawkfeather's residence was a row house and the home of the sage Ammathair Hawkfeather located in Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Ammathair Hawkfeather's residence was located in the west section of Waterdeep's Castle Ward on the western side of Swords Street just south of Keltarn Street.
